guitar.notes: Dave Matthews has long-standing association with Taylor Guitars, including signature models.

tone.target: jangly clean-to-edge Vox rhythm with subtle delay
tone.profile: jangly clean-to-edge Vox rhythm with subtle delay
tone.summary: A jangly, chimey rhythm tone built around a classic British clean amp model (AC30) paired with chorus and light compression for arpeggios.

rig.name: Dave Matthews Band - Crash Into Me - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide clean lift and brightness for arpeggios.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used to simulate a clean boost effect, avoiding the mid-hump of an OD pedal.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and open; no drive needed.
blocks.gap: The target is 'jangly clean,' so all distortion modules are bypassed.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Vox AC30 sound for chime and clarity.
Match the suggested 2x12 cabinet for a bright, focused sound.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is chosen as it aligns with the '2x12' clue and provides necessary brightness.

blocks.purpose: Provide the required 'chorus-like shimmer' and width for arpeggios.
Implement the required 'short delay' for rhythmic depth.
Add subtle ambience without heavy reverb.
blocks.gap: Room is preferred over Plate/Spring to maintain a natural, open sound suitable for DMB's style.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and tonal focus by swapping the current IR for a more vintage, open-sounding 2x12.

proposals.reason: The current IR is too focused; a vintage model will enhance the open, jangly tone.
